content.text:
Everything is set up and verified in the new space.

- **Space:** `e2e-haiku-01f490b8` (display name is also `e2e-haiku-01f490b8`, since no separate name was given).
- **Rule:** "E2E 589ea25a flight watch" (id `77c2e268-1dd5-40cf-bd19-7dae3e8af15c`), type `.es-query`, consumer `stackAlerts`.
  - Index `kibana_sample_data_flights`, time field `timestamp`, window 5 minutes.
  - Fires when the count is greater than 0.
  - Query is `match_all`, since you didn't specify a filter, so it counts every document in the window.
- **Status:** enabled. A re-read confirms `enabled: true`, with the schedule at the default 1m and no actions attached.

I didn't add any actions, so the rule will evaluate and show alerts but won't send notifications anywhere.
